name: Hand fix designs
ownerWords:
look, YOUR JOB IS TO MAKE SURE THE SOFTWARE IS DURABLE. 자체적으로 고쳐질 수 있게 설계를 바꾸는게 니 역할이야

문제를 고치는게 아니라 소프트웨어 엔지니어야 너는
goal: Every hand fix on prod or staging (a config write, a hand-started process, a thaw, a re-queue, a CI cancel or rerun) maps to a fault in the design list with a live design job, a fault whose design shipped stops needing hand fixes, and no prod-writing loop runs inside an agent session.

metrics.label: Hand fixes in 24 h that match no fault in the design list
Hand fixes in 24 h for a fault whose design step is done
Agent session processes that write to prod or staging
Box processes from docker exec, plus one-off containers left
Open faults with no live design job and no done design step
Data sources this check could not read

onMiss: Read the flagged items first. An undesigned hand fix: name its fault, add it to scripts/duties/hand-fixes.faults.json in sieun-pi with detect, correct and prove lines, and start a design job the same turn under p96 (c63). A repeat after a done design: reopen that design step with the hand fix as evidence and message its job. A session loop or a docker exec process: message its owner to move it into a supervised service. A fault without a job: start one under p96. Ship staging changes directly (c50), ask only for prod promotes, merge nothing without his go on that PR (c49), send nothing outside (c37). source_error: fix the read. All on target: end the turn with no message.
